note: The one record of the declared operating system (CLAUDE.md 'The declared machine'): native 32-bit Windows 7 SP1. Every value is read by tools (declared/gen_osrec.py, declared/gen_x86sys.py), never restated by hand. A WOW64 machine is another record.

major.source: MSDN 'Operating System Version' table (Windows 7 = 6.1) and OSVERSIONINFOEX.dwMajorVersion

minor.source: MSDN 'Operating System Version' table (Windows 7 = 6.1) and OSVERSIONINFOEX.dwMinorVersion

suite_mask.source: OSVERSIONINFOEX.wSuiteMask: VER_SUITE_SINGLEUSERTS = 0x100 (winnt.h), the suite of a Windows 7 workstation

native_arch.source: SYSTEM_INFO.wProcessorArchitecture: PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE_INTEL = 0 (x86), the native processor architecture of the declared machine

process_wow64.source: IsWow64Process: FALSE, the process is native 32-bit on a native x86 machine (MSDN IsWow64Process)
